subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 22, 2026
body:
Our continuous integration pipeline has just received another significant refinement, with the addition of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, making our ISO build process even more reliable and efficient. This improvement is a direct result of our community's efforts to refine and stabilize our workflow, ensuring that our users receive the most up-to-date and stable versions of AcreetionOS.

Development
The latest updates to our CI pipeline are a testament to the community's dedication to improving AcreetionOS, and we're excited to see the impact this will have on our users. For those interested in learning more about our development process, our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html provides a wealth of information on how to get involved and contribute to the project.

Community
The release of Emacs 31.1 has been a significant event for our community, with many users taking advantage of the new features and improvements. We're proud to offer our users access to the latest software packages through the Arch repositories, and our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html has guides on how to install and use Emacs, as well as many other popular applications. To stay up-to-date with the latest changes and updates, be sure to check out our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html. 

Tip of the day
For users looking to learn more about AcreetionOS and how to get the most out of their system, our website at https://acreetionos.org/ has a wealth of information and resources available, including a flash tutorial at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html that provides a quick introduction to the basics of our distribution.
